subject: general
question: Which of the following states bagged the first prize in the 3rd National Water Awards presented by then President of India, Shri Ram Nath Kovind in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Muzaffarnagar district of Uttar Pradesh bagged the best award in North Zone in the 'Best District' category while the second award went to Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar in Punjab.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has been awarded the first prize in the 3rd National Water Awards in the best state category, followed by Rajasthan and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The first National Water Award was launched by the Jal Shakti Ministry in 2018. 
 
• The Department of Water Resources, River Development, and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti gave 57 awards to states, organizations, etc. in 11 different categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Water Awards**

 
 
• **​**The National Water Awards aim to **promote water conservation**, **rainwater harvesting**, and **sustainable water management practices** in the country.
 
• They recognize and encourage efforts made by various stakeholders, including individuals, institutions, and communities, to effectively manage water resources.
 
• The awards were initiated by the **Ministry of Jal Shakti**, Government of India, in **2018**.
 
• They are awarded annually to recognize outstanding work in water conservation and management across different sectors and regions.
